add_definitions(
    -D_WINE
    -D_USE_MATH_DEFINES)

spec2def(dsound.dll dsound.spec ADD_IMPORTLIB)

# dsound.dll is all Rust (dsound-rust) and cargo links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/dsound-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
# How cmake compiled the target's sources, now on the OBJECT libraries.
add_library(dsound_shims OBJECT
    # buffer.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/dsound-rust/src/dsound/buffer.rs)
    # capture.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/dsound-rust/src/dsound/capture.rs)
    # dsound.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/dsound-rust/src/dsound/dsound.rs)
    # dsound_convert.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/dsound-rust/src/dsound/dsound_convert.rs)
    # dsound_main.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/dsound-rust/src/dsound/dsound_main.rs)
    # duplex.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/dsound-rust/src/dsound/duplex.rs)
    # mixer.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/dsound-rust/src/dsound/mixer.rs)
    # primary.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/dsound-rust/src/dsound/primary.rs)
    # propset.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/dsound-rust/src/dsound/propset.rs)
    # sound3d.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/dsound-rust/src/dsound/sound3d.rs)
    # guid.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/dsound-rust/src/dsound/guid.rs)
    rust_cohab_stub.c
    )
target_link_libraries(dsound_shims PRIVATE dxguid uuid wine libwinmm libadvapi32 libmsvcrt libkernel32 libntdll)
set_wine_module_fixme(dsound_shims)
add_cargo_module(dsound dsound-cargo dsound.dll
    KIND win32dll
    BODY_CRATE dsound-rust
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS dsound_shims psdk uuid_sources)
